quotes.author: Marcia Palmer
quotes.text: Marcia Palmer3 years agoThis is the guy you want to take you out on Savannah's waters. Mike's passion for his craft and his hometown waterways is beyond question. Fishing; bonding the young and old since time began. Capt. Mike helped in a big, big way installing the love of this sport in my kiddo, vs that online gaming thing. We could not be more grateful for his expertise and great spirit. The numerous trips we have had with him only make us want to go out again and again. Oh and the FISH! Yeah, that...please see picts. Cheers

quotes.author: Taylor M
quotes.text: Taylor M3 years agoBy far one of the best times we have had out fishing. Mike was awesome and knew exactly where to put us on the fish. We planned this trip very last minute right before a holiday and Mike was able to make the trip happen! Needless to say this was the spotlight of our trip to Savannah and we hope to do it again in the future.

quotes.author: James Titus
quotes.text: James Titus2 years agoJust recently took another remarkable charter with Captain Mike. Once you fish with Mike you’ll never charter with anyone else in the area. Not only does Mike put you on the fish, but makes the day a joyous occasion. I will be booking a few more trips before winter sets in. Thanks again Mike for a job well done.

quotes.author: SCB Designs INC
quotes.text: SCB Designs INC2 years agoMike was a GREAT fishing captain.He took his time, giving us fishing techniques, baiting our hooks, and telling us where to cast the line. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND booking with him whenever you're in the Savannah area. Also very communicative. Thanks again Captain Mike! Will be back soon! 😀 Camille & Bob

quotes.author: Matt Kravontka
quotes.text: Matt Kravontka2 years agoMike was the man. Excellent fishing trip, we caught almost every species of fish that we could have on this trip. He cleaned the flounder and red fish that we kept. Very positive and entertaining and all around great time. Highly recommend Mike he will put you on the fish!

quotes.author: Stephanie Dietrich
quotes.text: Stephanie Dietrich3 years agoMichael was a wonderful charter for my husband and I. Very professional, knowledgeable and reasonably priced. He took really good care of us and showed us a few honey holes for some great fishing spots. Will definitely be booking him again in the future!
